boundary_source_provider: 国家地理信息公共服务平台（天地图）
interpretation_limit: Remote-sensing tree cover only; not an official forest boundary, forest-resource survey, tree-species map, or fuel-load estimate
processing_method: WorldCover class 10 converted to 0/1 at native 10 m; area-weighted mean aggregated to 100 m overview pixels
source_sensor_or_model: Sentinel-1 SAR + Sentinel-2 MSI derived land-cover product
statistics_method: Tree-cover and valid-source areas summed from native-classification mask at 10 m for the province and 13 prefectures
value_meaning: 0--100 = percent of valid source area classified as WorldCover class 10; 255 = NoData
